facts.fact: 2026 festival runs 24 November–23 December with separate 31 December event at Theresienwiese.
Festival ground entry is free; specific shows have separate ticket arrangements.
Tollwood features organic international food and sustainable fair trade crafts.
facts.excerpt: with organic cuisine from around the world, sustainable and fair trade handicrafts

title: Tollwood Winter Festival 2026
notes: Relevant source passages read on 2026-11-01; only recorded facts used.
